comment: Shared sprite production standard for every Bladerift fighter. See docs/art/sprite-standard.md. Sheets below are the standard set; a character.json may override frames (sheets) or add notes (sheetNotes).
style: Premium, high-detail anime 2D fighting-game sprite art: the look of a carefully hand-pixelled character sprite rendered at high resolution - crisp deliberate dark outlines (not thick black cartoon lines), cel shading with three to four tones per material, bright specular highlights on metal, a cool rim light, an expressive face with a clear eye, anatomically correct hands with readable fingers, convincing anime anatomy, fluid hair and cloth that follow the motion. Exactly the rendering, palette and level of detail of the attached reference sheet. Not vector art, not blurry, not chibi, no photorealism.

idle.title: Stance and footwork
frames: combat idle loop 1: fighting stance, weapon ready, knees bent, weight centred
combat idle loop 2: the same stance breathing in, shoulders slightly raised, cape and hair drifting
combat idle loop 3: the same stance at the top of the breath
combat idle loop 4: the same stance breathing out, settling back toward frame 1
standing guard: weapon raised across the body to block, braced, chin down
crouch: low crouch on bent knees, weapon held low and ready (a crouching guard posture)
skid: braking hard from a run, front foot planted forward, body leaning back, cape swinging forward
landing: absorbing a landing from a jump, deep knee bend, one hand low for balance, cape still settling

run.title: Run cycle (8 frames, loops from frame 8 back to frame 1)
frames: run cycle 1: right foot contact, stride long, body leaning forward, weapon held ready at the side
run cycle 2: right foot down, body at its lowest
run cycle 3: passing pose, left knee driving forward, body rising
run cycle 4: left leg reaching forward, body at its highest, both feet briefly off the ground
run cycle 5: left foot contact, stride long (the mirror of frame 1)
run cycle 6: left foot down, body at its lowest
run cycle 7: passing pose, right knee driving forward, body rising
run cycle 8: right leg reaching forward, body at its highest, both feet off the ground

air.title: Jumping, falling, walls and ledges
frames: jump take-off: crouched spring an instant before leaving the ground
rising: leaping upward, legs tucked under, cape trailing down, weapon held back
apex: at the top of the jump, knees tucked, body compact, cape billowing
falling: descending, legs extending to land, cape and hair flowing upward
fast fall: diving straight down, body straight and streamlined, cape and hair streaming up
wall slide: back and left shoulder pressed against a wall on the LEFT, one hand bracing on it, sliding down, one foot scraping it
ledge hang: hanging by both hands from a ledge edge above the head, body dangling below, legs together
ledge climb: pulling up over the ledge, one knee up, chest over the edge

dash.title: Dodge, dash and healing
frames: dodge roll 1: dropping low into a forward roll
dodge roll 2: tucked into a tight ball mid-roll, cape wrapping around
dodge roll 3: rolling over the shoulder, nearly upside down
dodge roll 4: coming out of the roll into a low crouch, ready
ground dash: a fast low burst forward, body almost horizontal, faint speed lines behind
air dash: dashing horizontally through the air, body stretched forward, cape snapping behind
heal 1: pulling out a small glass flask of glowing red potion
heal 2: drinking the potion, head tipped back, a soft red glow

atk-a.title: Basic combo strikes 1 and 2 (3 frames each)
frames: combo strike 1, anticipation: drawing the weapon back for a quick slash
combo strike 1, strike: a fast horizontal slash forward with a bright weapon trail kept inside this cell
combo strike 1, recovery: the follow-through settling back toward stance
combo strike 2, anticipation: weight shifts, weapon raised high for a diagonal cut
combo strike 2, strike: a powerful diagonal cut with a bright arc trail kept inside this cell
combo strike 2, recovery: follow-through low, pulling back toward stance

atk-b.title: Combo finisher and aerial attack (3 frames each)
frames: combo finisher, anticipation: a big wind-up, weapon far back, front foot stepping in
combo finisher, strike: an overwhelming lunging strike, large bright arc trail kept inside this cell, the strongest pose
combo finisher, recovery: full extension relaxing, cape flaring, settling toward stance
aerial attack, anticipation: in mid-air, weapon raised
aerial attack, strike: a sweeping mid-air slash in front, bright arc trail kept inside this cell
aerial attack, recovery: airborne, body tucked, returning to a ready pose

atk-c.title: Plunge attack and heavy attack (3 frames each)
frames: plunge, dive: in mid-air diving straight down, weapon pointed down beneath the body, speed lines
plunge, impact: landing in a low crouch, weapon driven into the ground in front, a burst of light and dust
plunge, recovery: rising from the impact back toward stance
heavy attack, charge: body coiled, weapon held far back, a bright glow building on it
heavy attack, strike: a devastating full-power strike with a huge bright arc trail kept inside this cell
heavy attack, follow-through: deep follow-through, trail dissipating

hurt.title: Getting hit, knocked down and getting up
frames: light hit: flinching back from a blow, head snapped back, eyes squeezed
light hit recovery: catching the balance, guard coming back up
heavy hit: body bent backward by a heavy blow, arms flung out, pain on the face
launched: knocked off the feet and flying backward through the air
knockdown fall: falling onto the back, about to hit the ground
knocked down: lying flat on the back on the ground, weapon still in hand
getting up: pushing up onto one knee
back on guard: rising back into the fighting stance

art.title: Signature special move (Rift Art): anticipation, execution, recovery
frames: special anticipation 1: gathering power, a glowing aura starting
special anticipation 2: the instant before release, power at its peak
special execution 1: releasing the special move (its effect kept inside this cell)
special execution 2: the special move at full force (its effect kept inside this cell)
special recovery 1: power fading
special recovery 2: returning to stance

skill.title: Signature special (the hero's own SKILL, not the Rift Art): anticipation, execution, recovery
frames: special anticipation 1: winding up the hero's own special move, gathering its power, the pose coiling
special anticipation 2: the instant before release, the special's energy at its peak
special execution 1: releasing the special move (its effect kept inside this cell)
special execution 2: the special move at full force (its effect kept inside this cell)
special recovery 1: the special's energy fading
special recovery 2: returning to the fighting stance

misc.title: Skill throw, taunt and victory
frames: skill throw 1: reaching back with the free hand to throw a small item
skill throw 2: throwing it forward, arm extended
skill throw 3: follow-through after the throw
taunt 1: a confident taunt gesture (character-specific)
taunt 2: the taunt's second beat
victory 1: the start of the victory pose
victory 2: the victory pose at its height
victory 3: the victory pose held, cape and hair settling

ko.title: Defeat and intro
frames: defeat 1: staggering from the final blow
defeat 2: dropping to the knees, weapon slipping
defeat 3: collapsing forward
defeat 4: lying motionless on the ground
intro 1: walking in, weapon lowered, calm
intro 2: raising the weapon
intro 3: a flourish of the weapon
intro 4: settling into the fighting stance, ready
